name: master-detail
title: Master Detail
description: MasterDetail: a list with a detail pane, side by side on wide containers and stacked below 42rem with a Back button. Controlled or uncontrolled selection, optional URL sync through a router-agnostic adapter (hash routers included), j/k that follow focus, a detail that collapses to a rail or resizes, remembered under a storageKey, and focus that moves to the detail's heading and back to the row. Agents open and close items by the block's name.
docs: `<MasterDetail label="Devices" renderList={(state) => <List aria-label="Devices">{devices.map((d) => <ListItem key={d.id} title={d.name} {...state.itemProps(d.id)} />)}</List>} renderDetail={(id) => ({ title, description, actions, content })} emptyDetail={<Empty … />} />`. It fills its parent's height (`--master-detail-height`, 100% by default), so give it a bounded box, like an app shell's main column; in a page that scrolls, `height="auto"` sizes it to its content between `--master-detail-min-height` (16rem) and `--master-detail-max-height` (40rem) with the panes scrolling inside, instead of a hard-coded height (to fit what is left of the window, set the max from your app's own CSS). `idleDetail="visible"` keeps `emptyDetail` (a monitor, a summary) under the list on containers under 42rem, capped at `--master-detail-idle-height` (50%), with a button that collapses it to its bar (beside the list too with `collapsible`); `emptyDetailTitle` titles that bar and names the pane. `selectedId`, `defaultSelectedId` and `onSelectedIdChange` (cancel with `details.cancel()`); `url={createUrlParam("device")}` from `@/lib/url-param` keeps it in the URL (`{ in: "hash" }` for a hash route's query, `{ router: hashRouter() }` to go through a `UrlRouter` from `url-router` or your router's own API); for a route of your own shape (`#/devices/<id>`), control `selectedId` from the route instead; `followFocus` opens the row that j/k move to, but not a row whose action takes focus (give the `List` `rowActions` for Open, Copy or Start buttons on a row); `collapsible`, `resizable` and `storageKey` for the detail's width. Every label is in `labels`.
